name: Date picker
purpose: Core banking date input: an Input-fields boxed field (free typing, validates on blur) plus an anchored calendar panel opened from the tail button — month grid with full keyboard navigation, month/year paging, ink-knockout selection and a structural today ring. Itinerary row 14 (P1); built Phase-2 wave 2 (worker A continuation).

props.name: value
props.$note: DD/MM/YYYY (en-GB). Typing is free text — validated on blur, never masked mid-entry (acd-019: no auto-anything).

props.name: help
props.$note: Format hint above the field — 'Format: DD/MM/YYYY.' (copy-040: placeholder carries the format only).

props.name: minDate/maxDate
props.$note: Out-of-range days render disabled (kept out of the live demo; disabled cell treatment = text/disabled).

variants.name: closed

variants.name: open
variants.use: Anchored panel below the field: elevation recipe (shadow light / grey outline dark), 336px, 7×40px columns on the 4px grid.

tokens.$input-error-slot: OPEN (ADR-0010): still undeclared — binds semantic rag/error, follows the slot when declared (A-Q2).

behaviour.fallback: The text input works as a native field (DD/MM/YYYY typed by hand); the tail button does nothing and the panel never opens (`aria-expanded` stays false); no on-blur validation message, even for an impossible date.

$note.open: Tail button only (aria-haspopup=dialog + aria-expanded); focus lands on the focusable day (typed value, else today). Typing NEVER opens the panel.
$note.keyboard: Arrows move by day/week (crossing month edges pages the view) · Home/End = week edges · PageUp/PageDown = month, +Shift = year · Enter/Space selects · Escape closes and returns focus to the tail button. Roving tabindex — one tab stop in the grid.
$note.select: Writes DD/MM/YYYY into the input, clears any error, closes, returns focus.
$note.validation: On blur (not while the panel is open): empty = no error; malformed or impossible dates (31/02) error with 'Enter a real date, like …' (ctkn-020 'Enter…' + 3.3.3 suggestion). Error lifts as soon as the value re-validates.

behaviour.$fallbackRender: PROVEN by JS-off render #245 (2026-09-03): 7/7 named assertions held, JavaScript disabled at the context, page.goto(file://) — notes/_subreports/assets/2026-09-03-245-L2-populate/jsoff-render.json · jsoff-date-picker-{before,after}.png

accessibility.structure: Real <label for>; help + message joined via aria-describedby; panel = role=dialog (non-modal) with aria-label; grid = role=grid, day buttons = gridcells with full-date aria-labels.
accessibility.states: aria-selected on the chosen day; aria-current=date on today (the ring is never the only channel — aria carries it); aria-invalid + ink message text on error (1.4.1).
accessibility.focus: Two-tier focus (Input-fields decision B): aesthetic focus-within + :focus-visible ring with input-modality suppression; grid ring inset to survive the 4px gap.
accessibility.$note: 3.2.1 On Focus / 3.2.2 On Input are met (panel opens from the button only, typing never triggers context change — acd-019) but those SCs aren't in the compliance lookup yet, so kept out of relatedSC (Form-layout precedent).

antiPatterns: Opening the calendar on input focus (context change on focus — the panel opens from the tail button only).
Masking or auto-correcting the date mid-entry (acd-019: no auto-anything; validate on blur).
Colour-alone selected/today marking (selected = fill + weight + aria-selected; today = ring + aria-current).
type="date" native input (unstylable, inconsistent AT behaviour — text + inputmode=numeric is the pattern).
Local press-physics CSS on .dp-nav (ADR-0013: physics arrives via the injected partial).
Press physics on day cells (selection targets, not buttons).

tokenValidation.$note: input-error per-theme flex slot (ADR-0010) still undeclared — binding rag/error until it lands (A-Q2, receipt-flagged).
